name: AI SEO Masterclass - Bonus SOPs Templates and Checklists
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
The copy-paste section of the course: nine SOPs and templates. The most reusable parts for TAG are the 65-point local SEO checklist, the AI pre-publish checklist and the weekly task rhythm.

# Contents
- **B.1 ChatGPT ranking SOP:** the 10-day PBN plus guest post plan from Module 3, with prompts.
- **B.2 65-point local SEO checklist:**
  - Week 1 foundation (12): claim and verify GBP, 100% fields, 750-char description, 1 primary + up to 9 secondary categories, hours incl. holidays, attributes, local phone, website, 25+ photos, first post, first reviews.
  - Week 2 on-site (12): NAP in header area and footer, map embed on contact page, LocalBusiness JSON-LD, "[Service] in [City] | Brand" titles, city + service H1, clean URLs, internal links, local FAQ page, mobile tests.
  - Week 3 citations (8): top 10 directories, industry and local citations, aggregators, verify, fix NAP, track URLs, quarterly audit.
  - Week 4 reviews and content (8): 25 reviews, automated requests, review landing page, respond to all, weekly posts, local blogs, geo photos.
  - Weeks 5 to 8 advanced (15) and ongoing maintenance (10): weekly posts and review replies, monthly photos and rank checks, quarterly citation audits and hours updates, annual full audit.
- **B.3 Prompt library:** "Best X" listicle, comparison, how-to, and local "Best [Service] in [City]" prompts.
- **B.4 Cold email templates:** initial, day 3 follow-up with 3 audit findings, day 7 breakup, value-first free audit.
- **B.5 Reddit marketing SOP:** account farming and templated comments (excluded for TAG).
- **B.6 Client onboarding checklist:** day 1 access and assets, week 1 audit and strategy, week 2 implementation, week 3 content and links, week 4 results and retention.
- **B.7 Revenue tracking template.**
- **B.8 AI SEO pre-publish checklist:** 1,500+ words, human-edited, fact-checked, keyword in H1 and first 100 words, year in title, 3 to 5 internal links, 2 to 3 external authority links, FAQ 8 to 12, "Last updated", Article + FAQ schema validated, compressed images, under 3s, then submit to GSC and set 48-hour and 30-day reminders.
- **B.9 Weekly schedule:** Monday analysis, Tuesday content, Wednesday distribution, Thursday links and citations, Friday client work and reporting.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- B.2 and B.6 are good cross-checks for onboarding a new client like [Prestige Plumbing (Hub)](lib:brain-prestige-plumbing-hub).
- B.8 overlaps with the TAG blog checklist; TAG rules win where they differ (for example "Last updated" year claims and no unbacked stats).
- Review requests must never be gated or incentivized (see [Local SEO Lesson](lib:brain-local-seo-lesson) notes).
